title: Review: jmap-client (RFC 8620 base client)
description: Review pass on jmap-client: session fetch, JMAP request/response, blob, SSE, WebSocket. Correctness, elegance, Rust idioms.
notes:
Idiom rating: CLEAN — no ownership, lifetime, or unsafe issues. Code is well-structured and idiomatic. Findings are correctness bugs (wrong error variants P1/P3), API design gaps (missing #[non_exhaustive], wrong type for state), and minor style (drain vs split_off). No rewrite needed.
Rust idiom confidence: 90% chance of no missed issue. Least confident: SSE UTF-8 split handling edge cases — complex but looks correct. Uncertainty driven by: async stream lifetimes not statically verifiable without running.
